Do not run on real university records.

item.name: Login rejects a missing password

request.description: Login rejects a missing password. Expected HTTP 400 / VALIDATION_ERROR. This rejection must not change the seeded account. Backend contract: routes/api.js.

exec: pm.test("Invalid field is identified", () => pm.expect(data.details.some(d => d.field === "password")).to.eql(true));
pm.test("Rejected request returns no credentials", () => { for (const key of ["accessToken", "refreshToken", "passwordHash"]) pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property(key); });
